channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan to raise youth awareness about Northern Territories
item.description: Such efforts will include attracting school trips to areas close to the islands and sharing relevant information on social media.

item.title: IMF official welcomes Japan’s temporary tax cut plan
item.description: Rahul Anand, IMF assistant director and mission chief for Japan, said the approach was "a very welcome step."

item.title: Takaichi makes ritual offering to Yasukuni Shrine
item.description: The prime minister is expected to skip a visit to the Shinto shrine during the three-day festival, which runs through Monday.

item.title: BOJ’s Ueda ‘can’t tolerate’ underlying inflation further over 2%
item.description: The BOJ governor was speaking two weeks ahead of the bank's next policy decision, with observers currently anticipating no change at that gathering.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
